patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Amplemarket and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Amplemarket only if your buying job matches “AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, delivera” rather than Instantly's shape. Choose Instantly only if your buying job matches “Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358” rather than Amplemarket's shape. Workflow advantage: Amplemarket leans email-outreach; Instantly leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Amplemarket is AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, deliverability, and Duo AI assistants.; Instantly is Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358; bundles/credits add-ons; Enterprise custom..
- Workflow coverage skew: Amplemarket-leaning email-outreach vs Instantly-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Amplemarket — Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Instantly — Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core.

Limitations — Amplemarket: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Startup already $600/mo annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.; Instantly: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Lead finder/credits are add-on depth vs dedicated SI databases.
